title: Enable failure artifact backlog deletion
summary: Reports failure artifact cleanup now previews and deletes the current backend-owned artifact backlog by sending an explicit target_gb: 0 command override. The backend still requires the dry-run fingerprint, confirm_delete, and a non-empty reason before deletion.
reason: The Delete artifacts button stayed disabled when global cleanup settings were unset, even while artifact files were visible in the Reports table. Operators need the cleanup action to work without first tuning global retention settings.
behavior_before: Failure artifact cleanup depended on global retention/target settings. With defaults of 0, preview could plan zero files and leave Delete artifacts disabled even when failure artifact files were present.
behavior_after: Preview cleanup uses an explicit one-off target_gb: 0 override for the current failure artifact backlog. A successful preview with planned files enables Delete artifacts, and confirmed delete sends the same override plus the preview fingerprint and backend audit reason.
manual_validation: Read docs/testing/VALIDATION_LADDER_RUNBOOK.md for Local API command route and WebView validation rung.
rollback_plan: Revert the explicit target_gb: 0 frontend override and the backend explicit-zero policy handling. The route will return to global retention/target cleanup behavior only.
